      How this lesson supports every learner

      Engagement: the why of learning

      • Choose your pathway (SL only or SL + AHL) and your writing level (Support, Core, Challenge).
      • Set your own goals at the start and rate your confidence at the end.
      • Every slide links to the real world ("Why it matters") and has a Think–pair–share prompt.
      • Unlimited retries; scores stay private on your device.

      Representation: the what of learning

      • Every point is narrated in a UK voice, with captions and a read-along transcript.
      • Tap underlined key words for a definition; full glossary in Learning tools.
      • Ideas appear as text, diagrams, interactive models and data tables (switch any graph to a table).
      • Change text size, font, spacing, contrast, theme, speed and motion.

      Action and expression: the how of learning

      • Show what you know in different ways: choose, order, fill in, build, flip and write.
      • Optional hints before you answer; feedback explains the reasoning.
      • Worked examples step by step, then practice without support.
      • Success criteria and a progress tracker help you check your own work. Everything works with a keyboard.
